title: Campaign Session Cadence and Attendance
dataSources: Campaign sessions (`campaign:session`), NPC ledger (`npc:ledger`), loot drops (`loot:drop`), XP awards (`xp:award`).
app: Tabletop RPG telemetry — virtual-tabletop session logs (Roll20, Foundry VTT), campaign trackers (World Anvil), and XP / loot / NPC ledgers — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=campaign:session
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as sessions, avg(players_present) as avg_attendance by _time campaign
| sort - _time
description: Tracks how often your campaign meets and how many players show up, the pulse of a healthy game group.
value: Campaigns die from irregular sessions and dropping attendance; a cadence view helps a group stay committed.
implementation: Ingest session logs into `index=personal`; trend session frequency and attendance.
visualization: Column chart of monthly sessions with average attendance.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks how often your role-playing group meets and who shows up, keeping the campaign alive.
